type SyntaxSlashCommand = {
  /** Markdown inserted in source view. */
  markdown: string

  /** Caret offset within the inserted Markdown. Defaults to its end. */
  cursor?: number
  /** Extra slash-menu search terms. */
  keywords?: string

}
